name: OpenRAM 1.2.48
maintenance_status: ACTIVE; latest listed release v1.2.48 at commit b6a6f12
supported_pdks: SKY130; FreePDK45; SCMOS 0.35; other private/research plug-ins
available_technology_plugins: sky130; freepdk45; scn4m_subm; external/private technology paths
characterization_support: YES; analytical by default; SPICE characterization with -c; DRC/LVS/PEX selectable
read_write_energy_support: YES; SPICE characterization reports read/write dynamic and leakage power
openroad_compatibility: CONDITIONAL_YES; LEF/GDS/Liberty/Verilog are standard ASIC views and upstream documents open-source-flow integration
opensta_compatibility: YES; generated Liberty is consumable by OpenSTA but must pass a local parser/corner audit
reproducibility: HIGH when compiler version/config/PDK revision/corner/tool versions are pinned
installation_complexity: HIGH for full SKY130 layout+verification+SPICE; Nix is the current preferred toolchain
known_limitations: SKY130 flow has current open issues including Liberty internal-power correctness and LEF/LVS details; generated artifacts require local qualification; current docs say GF180 SRAM generation is unsupported
comparability_to_date_sky130hd: CONDITIONALLY_COMPARABLE: same SKY130 technology family and 1.8 V nominal condition are possible; exact sky130hd PDK lineage, tt 1.8 V 25 C Liberty, interface, useful capacity, and characterization boundary must be verified before numerical joining

name: SRAM22 0.2.0
available_technology_plugins: slightly modified SKY130 PDK; sky130_fd_sc_hs support cells
supported_depths: CONFIGURABLE; num_words/mux_ratio must yield a power-of-two row count with at least 16 rows
supported_word_widths: 8..128 bits for the open interpolation Liberty model; generated array must have at least 16 columns; width must be divisible by write_size
banking_support: PARTIAL; multiple SRAM configurations may be generated but no documented internal multi-bank option
generated_liberty: YES; tt/ss/ff Liberty always generated; open build uses interpolation
generated_spice: YES; plain SPICE netlist is referenced by the characterization flow
characterization_support: PARTIAL; open interpolation model or proprietary Liberate MX/SPICE characterization
read_write_timing_support: YES; Liberty setup/hold/delay; open interpolation model claims conservative overestimate up to 2% for widths 8..128
read_write_energy_support: NOT_ASSESSABLE without full characterization; upstream pre-generated repository says detailed characterization is still in progress
openroad_compatibility: YES_WITH_EVIDENCE; the Chipyard SKY130 OpenROAD tutorial uses SRAM22 macros
opensta_compatibility: YES; standard Liberty timing views, subject to local parser/corner audit
reproducibility: MEDIUM; TOML config and Rust lockfile help, but exact modified-PDK revision and feature boundary must be frozen
installation_complexity: HIGH; Rust 1.81, modified SKY130 PDK, and sky130_fd_sc_hs; proprietary tools required for DRC/LVS/PEX/simulation/Liberate
known_limitations: Only SKY130; mux 4/8; open Liberty interpolation width 8..128; full physical verification and simulated characterization require BWRC/commercial access; pre-generated macros carry no performance guarantee
comparability_to_date_sky130hd: NOT_YET_NUMERICALLY_COMPARABLE: nominal SKY130 and 1.8 V overlap, but modified PDK, sky130_fd_sc_hs support-cell identity, interpolation or commercial characterization boundary, exact corner temperature, and capacity must be reconciled
